notes:
v0.6.29: fix tag discovery in bootstrap script (3-segment filter).

`git ls-remote --tags --sort=-v:refname` returns 'v0.6' BEFORE
'v0.6.28' because git treats 'v0.6' as 'v0.6.0' and version
comparison puts v0.6.0 > v0.6.28. The script's `head -1`
picked up v0.6 (the older 2-segment tag) and pinned the
working tree to that, which is way out of date.

Fix: filter the ls-remote output to only 3-segment tags
(vX.Y.Z) before taking head -1. The awk regex '/refs\/tags\/v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/'
matches exactly the 3-segment version tags. Then sed strips
the refs/tags/ prefix and the ^{} peeled-tag suffix.

After this fix, the script will pin to v0.6.28 (the actual
latest at the time of the fix) instead of v0.6.
